summary: A Depth subscription on an NFO future with OI: V2 ticks with the five-level book, an update of both sides, then sides Firstock marks invalid (a sentinel level among valid ones, a side of sentinels, a side of zero levels), then a valid book again.

notes: Depth mode's OI is i_total_open_interest on both (firstock_adapter.py:862; brokers/firstock/streaming.rs tick).

Firstock has no book-clear signal the web acts on: a level whose price, quantity or orders is 9223372036854775808, or with neither price nor quantity, is dropped, and a side left without a valid level keeps the previous side (firstock_adapter.py:683-744). Audit FB-02, fixed: the desktop filters a side the same way before it stores it (brokers/firstock/streaming.rs valid_level, merge).

deviations.reason: Firstock's i_last_trade_time is in epoch seconds and the web sends it unchanged as ltt; feed timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop sends the trade time in ms.

Firstock's tick carries last_quantity and the web's Depth dict leaves it out (firstock_adapter.py:854-865): market data the broker sent, lost (lead ruling 2026-11-09). The desktop's Depth frame keeps it, with the rest of the instrument's latest quote, as docs/api/websocket-streaming/depth.md shows the trade quantity and book totals.

The web pads a side with fewer than five valid levels to five with zero levels Firstock did not send (_extract_depth_data); a book carries the levels the broker sent (lead rule 2026-11-09). The desktop sends the two valid bids alone.
